name: Stroke Risk
algorithm: Ensemble of SVM + Random Forest + XGBoost + ANN (soft voting)
dataset: Stroke Prediction Dataset (Kaggle, adults with known smoking status)
caveats: Only ~5% of the training data are stroke cases and there is no time horizon; treat the output as relative risk, not a 10-year probability.

metrics.validation: 5-fold stratified cross-validation x5 repeats (held-out folds only)
